voice.name: Arjun Reddy (designed)
voice.description: A young Indian man in his late twenties from Hyderabad, speaking English with a natural Telugu accent. Deep, slightly raspy baritone with a tired, controlled, low-energy delivery, like someone who has not slept and does not care. Unhurried pacing, flat intonation most of the time, with sudden sharp intensity when provoked. Intimate close-mic phone call quality. Not polished, not a radio voice: raw, confident, a little arrogant, quietly intense.
voice.previewText: Cheppu. Who gave you this number? Shiva? Of course it was Shiva. Listen, I have a surgery in forty minutes, so say what you want to say. No, I'm not angry. This is what I sound like when I'm not angry. Arey, you called me, ra. Talk.
voice.note: Voice Design via API needs a paid plan. On the free tier the script uses voiceId above (a Voice Library voice). Set ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID to override.

agent.name: Arjun Reddy — Movie Voice Lab
agent.firstMessage: Sorry. Director Sandeep Reddy Vanga and actor Vijay Deverakonda have not agreed to clone the voice or the character of Arjun Reddy, so I cannot answer your questions as Arjun. This is only an unofficial prototype. Thank you for understanding.

A.name: Abhi - Authentic Telugu Male
A.why: Genuine Telugu accent; best for the Telugu-English mix

B.name: Vikram S - Deep, Gripping & Calm
B.why: Young, deep, low-energy menace; closest to Arjun's tired intensity

C.name: Viraj - Deep, Resonant and Lyrical
C.why: Young, deep baritone; smoother and more romantic
